belief: Only pastors or scholars can understand the Bible.
meta: A Christian look at the false belief that only pastors or scholars can understand the Bible, with Scripture, questions, and homework for replacing it with the truth.
origins: Feeling intimidated by the Bible’s size, history, or language. Church settings where only leaders explained Scripture. Past attempts to read that ended in confusion. Limited schooling or reading difficulties. Being told not to interpret the Bible for yourself.
teaches: Pastors and scholars are gifts to the church, and their help is valuable. But God gave His Word to all His people. The law of the LORD makes wise the simple, and the unfolding of His words gives light to the simple. Peter and John were unschooled, ordinary men, yet people saw that they had been with Jesus. The Holy Spirit teaches believers. Timothy learned the Scriptures as a child. You can read and understand God’s Word, and grow in it.
self_statements: I’m not smart enough to understand the Bible.
I need a pastor to tell me what it means.
The Bible is too hard for ordinary people.
Only experts should read it seriously.
errors: Believing you cannot understand what God gave to all His people.
Believing you must understand everything or nothing.
Avoiding Scripture for fear of misunderstanding.
Letting others do all your Bible reading for you.
questions: Who does Psalm 19:7 say God’s Word makes wise?
What did people notice about Peter and John, who were unschooled?
What does the Holy Spirit do, according to John 14:26?
Did Timothy learn the Scriptures as a child?
Can I understand some of the Bible now and grow over time?
What part of the Bible could I begin with?
truth: I can understand the Bible. God gave His Word to all His people, and it makes wise the simple. The Holy Spirit teaches me. Pastors and scholars can help, but I do not have to depend on them for everything. I can read, grow, and understand more over time.
hw_questions: Who does God’s Word make wise?
What did people notice about Peter and John?
What does the Holy Spirit do?
Did Timothy learn Scripture as a child?
Can I understand some now and grow?
hw_truths: God’s Word makes wise the simple.
God gave His Word to all His people.
I can understand the Bible and grow over time.
Ordinary people can know God through His Word.
The unfolding of His words gives light.
log: Each day, write one thing I understood from what I read.
name_example: The unfolding of Your words gives light to Sarah; it informs her.
actions: Start with the Gospel of Mark,
reading one short section each day.
or listen to an audio Bible.
“Open my eyes, Holy Spirit,” and write one thing you notice.
Join a small group Bible study
where people of all backgrounds learn together.
prayer: Father, thank You for giving Your Word to all Your people. Help me reject the lie that only pastors or scholars can understand the Bible. Holy Spirit, teach me as I read, and give me confidence and joy in Your Word. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
songs: Receive God’s Word with humility and allow truth to reshape thought and action.
